all.title: Four Ideas, Curated From Life
all.story: Every piece in our archive began long before FEKRA existed—as a spontaneous doodle during an SAT prep lecture, a song that hit at the right second, a mood that needed words, or an anniversary stitched onto a sleeve.

rasma.title: Born From A Bored Doodle In An SAT Prep Class
rasma.story: During a quiet SAT course, a friend was absentmindedly sketching in the margins of a notebook. Looking over at those raw, unscripted ink strokes, one thought sparked: what if this effortless moment became a graphic tee? Rasma keeps the original pen line exactly as it was drawn.

8any.title: When A Song Becomes An Image In Your Mind
8any.story: 8any started the moment a song played and triggered an immediate, vivid emotion—translating sound waves into a mental picture, and finally onto a tee. Each piece captures the rhythm, nostalgia, and late-night feel of music you feel in your chest.

e7sasy.title: Wearing The Mood You Cannot Put Into Words
e7sasy.story: Created from a simple personal desire: wanting a T-shirt that expresses your exact internal mood or state of mind without saying a word. E7sasy turns vulnerability, calm, and inner intensity into minimalist typographic and abstract designs.

7oby.title: Matching Tees, A Date On The Sleeve, And A Birthday Surprise
7oby.story: It started with a simple wish: matching tees with our dates printed on the sleeves. Time went by and we forgot all about the idea—until her birthday, when I surprised her with them. 7oby is that surprise, made for two: a matching pair of tees, with a date that matters to you on both sleeves if you like.
